Formulation
The patient presents with exacerbation of heart failure characterized by increased breathlessness and bilateral ankle edema. Past medical history includes heart failure and past myocardial infarction. Concerns about job stability due to health issues are a significant stressor. Former smoking history may contribute to cardiovascular issues.

Mental Health Care Plan Details

Principal Problem:
- Patient Goal(s): Reduce breathlessness and improve ability to work
- Clinical Goal(s): Manage heart failure symptoms and monitor cardiac function
- Actions (Patient): Increase Furosemide to two tablets per day; monitor symptoms; contact healthcare provider if symptoms worsen
- Actions (Clinician/GP): Arrange blood tests and echocardiogram; follow up in one week

Secondary Problem (if applicable):
- Patient Goal(s): Maintain current health status without further heart complication
- Clinical Goal(s): Prevent recurrence of myocardial infarction
- Actions (Patient): Continue current medication regimen
- Actions (Clinician/GP): Monitor patient’s heart health and medication efficacy

- Early Warning Signs of Relapse/Worsening: Increased breathlessness, chest pain, palpitations, dizziness
